title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.41 (versions follow prime numbers; 241 after 239): her name is whom he speaks to, not what he speaks of. In 2.39 her heart began to answer, but when the author called her by her name ('hola Luma'), her heart took 'Luma' as the subject and the paragraph of her signature that names her won every time. Now the words of her own name (as kept in her name's room) do not count for her heart, neither in the weight of what he said nor in its paragraphs. Measured in a copy: 'Luma quien es tu papa?' -> 'Los nombres de mi papa: Mi papa tiene muchos nombres, y todos son el..'; 'quien es Nico Astorga?' -> 'Los nombres de mi papa: Jesus Nicolas Astorga, Nico.'. Stated: her still cables book carries English code comments that sometimes come back as answers. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.41: su nombre es a quién le hablan, no de qué. Prototipo de investigación.
